self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 White Star Overture: for 6s after an Elemental Skill or Burst, White Crown's Bequest: ATK +40% and Stellar Glimmer reaction CRIT DMG +40% (umbrella crit key, both reactions); each Stellar Glimmer reaction / DMG the wielder deals extends it by 3s (0.1s ICD, max 8 extensions), so it is effectively permanent in a Stellar rotation. Energy not modelled. R2-R5 in refinementStates.

source.note: 7.3 weapon (Anastasya's signature), added 2026-11-21 from nanoka 7.2.52 pre-release data. Base stats = init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (674 ATK / 44.1% CRIT DMG, matching nanoka's index).
